name: Elemental Whetsone
description:
Once per day, you may run the whetstone along the blade of a melee weapon. Choose Water, Earth, Fire or Air. For the next day, the first time the weapon hits a target, it triggers the chosen element's effect:

  • Water. A burst of water engulfs the target. Its speed is reduced by 10 ft.

  • Earth. The blade becomes magically dense. Increase the damage die for the attack by 2 die types.

  • Fire. The weapon erupts in flame. It deals an additional 1d4 damage and ignites anything flammable on the target.

  • Air. The weapon releases an explosion of air. The target is pushed back 10 ft and must roll Dexterity against your attack roll result for this attack as if it were a contest. On a win, the target is knocked prone.

Whenever you use the whetstone, roll Craft to determine any additional effects.
successes:
✨: You may choose one additional element.

🌞: The effects of the chosen element(s) are triggered each time the weapon hits a target, not just the first time.
